title: Travel to work areas, December 2011 (United Kingdom, generalised, clipped)
description: Areas within which most residents also work, built from commuting flows rather than administration.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Travel_to_Work_Areas_Dec_2011_GCB_in_United_Kingdom_2022" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Travel_to_Work_Areas_Dec_2011_GCB_in_United_Kingdom_2022/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 228 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
